en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial complex in a forested valley. Several long factory buildings with pitched roofs and tall chimneys sit among hills covered with dense trees. Smoke rises from some of the chimneys. The layout suggests a large porcelain works or similar manufacturing plant surrounded by rural landscape. At the top in red Gothic-style script is German text identifying the location and the porcelain factory.
